finalText:
The build now finishes with exit code 0.

Two real bugs caused the failure, both from the dependency bump:

- `src/core/options.js:6` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the correct key.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` the same as `false`.

The rest of the output (DEP0xxx warnings, dedupe notes, tree-shaking notes) is normal noise from the bumped bundler and does not need a fix.
